[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books for beginners in quantum physics:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Quantum Mechanics: The Theoretical Minimum" by Leonard Susskind and Art Friedman - A clear and accessible introduction to quantum physics.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "The Elegant Universe" by Brian Greene - Overview of quantum physics in an engaging way.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Quantum: A Guide for the Perplexed" by Jim Al-Khalili - Beginner-friendly introduction to quantum physics and its applications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "The Quantum Universe: Everything That Can Happen Does Happen" by Brian Cox and Jeff Forshaw - Overview of quantum mechanics and its implications, written clearly.
